purpose: Teach: ありふれ/眠ら/怯え/おろそか/膨れ/太り/はいり/たたい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ありふれた挨拶でもお客様の心を温めるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you warm people's hearts even with the simplest greeting.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Warm affection underneath. Gentle cadence, like she's noticing something she's grateful for. Slight pause before speaking, the way someone does when they're choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、眠らずに仕事を片付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer came in without sleeping—worked through the night.
lines.style: Quiet, steady noticing. The tone of someone who remembers details about people. Matter-of-fact but with gentleness underneath. Pace unhurried, like she's painting the picture slowly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、雷雨で怯えてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And when the storm rolled in, they were so frightened.
lines.style: Softer now, almost protective in the tone. Slow delivery. The slight emphasis on "so frightened" carries empathy. Trailing off gently, inviting connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への気遣いをおろそかにしないようにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's why we can't let our care for them slip, even for a moment.
lines.style: Steady and direct, but not commanding. The tone of someone speaking a quiet truth she believes in. Firm without hardness. Eye-level sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケーキでお腹が膨れたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: But they had a slice of cake and felt full afterward.
lines.style: Lighter now, small observation. The cadence of someone noticing a detail with gentle curiosity. Warm but unforced. Like mentioning something she saw.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、最近少し太り気味だって気にされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I noticed they've been worried lately—worried they've put on weight.
lines.style: Careful delivery. The sensitivity of someone holding something tender. Quiet understanding in the tone. Not judgmental, just aware. Slight hesitation that shows she's being thoughtful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店にはいりたそうにドアを覗かれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They kept peeking through the door like they wanted to come in.
lines.style: Soft, curious observation. Slow pace. The tone of someone noticing what others miss—the hesitation, the longing. Gentle and almost wondering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リズムに合わせて軽くテーブルをたたいてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I saw them tapping the table lightly, keeping time with the music.
lines.style: The quietest delivery yet. Almost private observation. Slow, steady rhythm matching the tapping itself. A smile in the voice—the joy of noticing small, genuine moments.
